summary: 1934 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 20-foot enclosed timber tower in Klamath NF, Siskiyou County; NHLR-registered 2020; 2024 Forest Service camera project.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on a 20-foot enclosed timber tower
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Klamath National Forest

events.note: NHLR gives construction for the Klamath NF in 1934; forest chronology, as cited by the weebly page, says construction was completed by a CCC crew
Photo credit only: Happy Camp Complex fire as seen from the lookout, Sept. 5, 2014; no damage or staffing information in the source
Registered April 15, 2020 as US 1417, CA 223; nominated by Brad Eells
Forest Service project decision signed 11/05/2024 covering two wildfire cameras and a solar panel array adjacent to the tower; installation not confirmed by the sources

notes_for_editor: Brief had no build event; 1934 added from NHLR and the weebly page. height_m 6.1 is converted from the NHLR 20-foot tower height. Brief's record (elevation 1674.6 m, agency, registration 2020) matches NHLR; no corrections. Staffing, access, and current condition beyond the 2024 Forest Service project were not found in the pages read; the 1942 and 1953 Klamath County items seen in a search snippet were not attributed because the page was not read. Whether the camera and solar work was installed is unconfirmed.
